description: Defines the template class DataLoaderBase for data loading in PyTorch, including thread management, batching, and iterator interface.

classes.name: DataLoaderBase
classes.description: A template class providing a base implementation for data loaders with thread management, batching, and iteration capabilities.

methods.name: DataLoaderBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing DataLoader with options and optional dataset.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the start of data loading.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns a sentinel iterator indicating the end of data.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins worker threads and drains queues.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Returns the configuration options used for the DataLoader.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state and prefetches data.

methods.name: prefetch
methods.description: Schedules batch requests for data loading.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of data, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: worker_thread
methods.description: Function run by worker threads to process data.

methods.name: push_job
methods.description: Adds a job to the shuttle with a sequence number.

methods.name: pop_result
methods.description: Retrieves the next result from the sequencer.

methods.name: new_sequencer
methods.description: Creates a sequencer based on ordering options.
